clause_ref: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text:
Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
Bharat Unity Bank Ltd.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 1. Purpose and Scope

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
1. Purpose and Scope
text: 1.1 This Policy governs the processing of digital personal data by the Bank in its capacity as a Data Fiduciary under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 2. Governance

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
2. Governance
text: 2.1 Data Protection Officer [DPR-C01]. The Bank shall designate a Data Protection Officer based in India who shall be the point of contact for grievance redressal, and shall publish the business contact details of the Data Protection Officer on its website and mobile application. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
2. Governance
text: 2.2 DPIA and independent data audit [DPR-C02]. The Bank shall conduct an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit, and report the outcome to the Board Risk Management Committee. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 3. Notice and Consent

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
3. Notice and Consent
text: 3.1 Privacy notice at collection [DPR-C03]. Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data to be processed and the purpose of processing, available in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, at the customer's option. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
3. Notice and Consent
text: 3.2 Consent capture and logging [DPR-C04]. Consent shall be obtained through a clear affirmative action, shall be specific to each purpose, and shall be logged with timestamp, purpose code and notice version. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 4. Purpose Limitation

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
4. Purpose Limitation
text: 4.1 Purpose limitation and data inventory [DPR-C05]. Personal data shall be processed only for the purpose for which consent was given or for legitimate uses permitted by law, and the Bank shall maintain an inventory of personal data categories, purposes and systems. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
4. Purpose Limitation
text: 4.2 Children's personal data [DPR-C06]. Before processing personal data of a child, the Bank shall obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian and shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children. Control owner: Head of Retail Banking. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 5. Security Safeguards

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
5. Security Safeguards
text: 5.1 Reasonable security safeguards [DPR-C07]. The Bank shall implement reasonable security safeguards, including encryption, masking and access control, to prevent personal data breach. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Continuous.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 6. Retention and Erasure

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
6. Retention and Erasure
text: 6.1 Retention schedule [DPR-C08]. Retention periods for each category of personal data shall be specified in the Retention Schedule at Annexure A, which shall be reviewed annually. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
6. Retention and Erasure
text: 6.2 Erasure after account closure [DPR-C09]. Personal data of customers whose accounts have been closed, including KYC documents, shall be erased from all systems within 180 days of account closure. Control owner: Head of Operations. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
text: 7. Rights of Data Principals

heading_path: Personal Data Protection and Retention Policy
7. Rights of Data Principals
text: 7.1 Data principal requests [DPR-C10]. Requests from Data Principals for access to, correction, completion or updating of their personal data shall be resolved within 30 days of receipt. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.
Annexure A: Retention Schedule

heading_path: Annexure A: Retention Schedule
text: A.1 This Schedule was last reviewed in August 2021 and is aligned with the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011.

heading_path: Annexure A: Retention Schedule
text: A.2 Customer identification and KYC documents: 180 days after account closure.

heading_path: Annexure A: Retention Schedule
text: A.3 Account and transaction data: 180 days after account closure, except where retained in books of account.

heading_path: Annexure A: Retention Schedule
text: A.4 CCTV footage at branches: 90 days.
